_comment: Per-scene limits in 8-bit levels (0-255) on sRGB-encoded pixels. mae = mean absolute error over all pixels and channels. max = largest allowed single-channel error. outliers = fraction of pixels allowed above max (default 0); only for patterns with discontinuities or poles, where Cycles' random pixel samples and the browser's 4x4 grid cover edges differently. Tighten over time.
